responsibility: Defines the builtin preprocessor macros exposed by C-family front ends and targets. It computes and installs standard predefined macros for integer and floating-point properties, target and ABI characteristics, <float.h> and <stdint.h>-style limits and suffix macros, and other configuration constants, combining generic C-family logic with target hooks and cpplib callbacks, including lazy expansion support for expensive exact floating-point macro values.
